payload.text: **0085 is landed at 76cb09d and is with vc for review.** Every gate opener now names where its command line came from. The population turned out to be SIX, not the five dc's issue table claimed: the class arm -- every run_gate call carries --source within its own span -- named bin/.devbin/cmd/test:30 the first time it ran, which dc's census had read past because it walked lib/ and bin/devbin only. 4 arms, each red first; 6 mutants, each killed at its own arm with every restore cmp-equal, and the different-terms mutant dies at the parity arm alone. Nine suites 1..516, 516 ok; syntax and lint 45 files 0 breaches. Declared limit, written into the issue: fullcycle's and the test handler's seals have no behavioural arm, so the class arm is their only cover. One scope call is with vc -- whether the three devbin-owned sites are inside its fence; taking them out is a clean subtraction. The Fixed section is drafted at scratchpad/review-0082/0085-fixed.md and dc closes 0085 on vc's OK.
